rules.read_basis: User-provided root rules and previously fully read matching hash
Root instructions provided/previously fully read; crates rules reread fully for this assignment

verdict: The carried bool is a closed semantic observation policy; replace it with the shared enum chosen by root. Two effective policy states suffice; ownership, target and presentation are separate axes. No product edits performed.

recommended_shape.owner: One shared owner under globals validation observation/scope responsibility, exported to fabelgeist-compute; reuse it in context field/getter and pipeline parameter.
recommended_shape.declaration: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub enum ValidationObservation { BlockingScopes, Uncaptured }
recommended_shape.root_selected_native_adapter: #[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))] fn start_scope(self, device: &wgpu::Device) -> Option<wgpu::ErrorScopeGuard> { match self { BlockingScopes => Some(device.push_error_scope(wgpu::ErrorFilter::Validation)), Uncaptured => None } }
recommended_shape.field: Prefer private validation_observation: ValidationObservation plus a copied enum getter when other crates need it. Do not retain public bool/compatibility accessor or pass a derived bool between application APIs.
recommended_shape.factories: from_parts => Uncaptured; native open/new/new_compute => BlockingScopes; wasm open/new/new_compute => Uncaptured. Clone retains policy unchanged. Public raw-device get_or_create_pipeline default currentlytrue becomes explicit BlockingScopes, preserving present default rather than inferring ownership from device handle.
recommended_shape.validity: Mode expresses scoped synchronous observation versus delegating to uncaptured/native provider policy. It does not certify device ownership, absence of other submitters, global device health or all constructor behavior.
recommended_shape.payload: No payload belongs in either policy variant: device exists in both. Keep device+same-thread guard in ValidationScope; start_scope returns the actual native optional guard without creating a bool adapter.

Indirect shared-owner consumers already classified in prior exact source reviews; no direct bool. Preserve cache-first and finish-before-cache behavior; not newly full-body audited here.

reuse_search.terms: enum .*Validation; enum .*Presentation; ValidationPolicy; ValidationMode; ContextOwnership; DeviceOwnership; plus all blocking_validation/get_or_create_pipeline_validated repository Rust occurrences
reuse_search.result: No equivalent existing observation-policy enum found. Existing ValidationScopeError is outcome, wgpu PollType is poll operation and cannot replace decision to create/pop a scope. TextureViewOperation is texture dimension, not policy.
reuse_search.limits: Search current repository Rust sources, no full global architecture/semantic lens clearance.

serialization_and_transitions.serialization: WgpuContext derives Clone only; policy/scope/error have no Serde or Boolean wire encoding in inspected source. No wire bool conversion or migration required.
serialization_and_transitions.transitions: Only constructors assign observation state; Clone copies it; consumers inspect it. Current public bool permits arbitrary mutation, but no in-tree setter/mutation found beyond constructor assignment. Private enum field/getter avoids trivial bypass without claiming immutable device/queue association.
serialization_and_transitions.histories: Keep meaningful optional captured native cause even when poll failed. Presentation payload absence and cached shader/pipeline diagnostics are independent/historical concerns, not state derived from observation mode.

acceptance_criteria_for_root_implementat: No blocking_validation bool field, bool pipeline parameter or implicit true/false policy conversion remains at any listed real consumer; one shared enum flows through them.
Constructor matrix and wasm cfg match current behavior. No Owned/Borrowed/Browser policy mega-enum or presentation consolidation bundled into this fix.
ValidationScope continues owning matching actual device and guard and consumes pop once; required poll error plus optional captured native cause both retained.

No new compatibility alias/forwarder, tests/cases/helpers/assertions/doctests. Existing test expressions may be adjusted only to consume new API if authorized by root; no execution performed by reviewer.
Root independently runs only authorized existing required checks after implementation; this source proposal supplies no runtime evidence.
coverage_limits: Initial source pass for this narrow reviewed enum family complete. No source/product/Git/ledger edits, project checks/tests/probes or external messages; only ignored report authored.
Current constructor/subresource validation-policy inconsistencies, public device/queue association, broader F9 commentary/SDK polling rationale and all audit families not closed.
